answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 4893 Country: MW Title: Can Mothers alone attend madresa progress meeting with moulana's & madresa committe behind pardah? if yes, can we ask their views in front of everybody ? Please explain in details. Question: Can Mothers alone attend madresa progress meeting with moulana's & madresa committe behind pardah? if yes, can we ask their views in front of everybody ? Please explain in details. Jaza kallah Answer ID: 4893 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1370/1044=H/1429) It is unlawful to have the women in the committee. However, there is no wrong for the women to give any advice through their husbands or mahram in the good cause of madrasa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
